fit_order_and_volume_limitations: The finite-g increase and held-out prediction are measured; intercepts depend on fit order. Fixed-spacing matter-volume changes are material. No fit is promoted to a physical or continuum g prediction.

same_refined_source_precession.finite_g_definition: 2 E_star |Delta unwrapped arg<Sx+iSy>|/(B T), where E_star is the true zero-probe minimum of the same one-particle quasistatic construction and T=6000. This is a finite-duration precession normalization, distinct from dividing static moment by measured canonical spin.
same_refined_source_precession.ground_identification: The zero-field antiunitary with square-1 and exact chiral symmetry give a fourfold |D| ground quartet. At nonzeroB two isolated positive eigenlines plus chiral partners account for all four levels below the rigorous fifth-level bound. Four identical native blocks retain all16internal rows.

moment_readout_error.complete_binary_instrument: effects(I+/-M_j/L_mu)/2 on the full signed kernel; probabilities are computed from the prepared pair with the stated state/field/negative-branch error

probe_all_mode_gap.proof: Re<beta v,Dv>=<v,Mv> and singular-value min-max; the scalar M0 separates into three exact tridiagonal axes. Four internal copies give the fifth-eigenvalue bound.

probe_exact_matrix_residuals.method: Exact rational matvec of degree18 link-phase polynomial, coordinate residual norm bound and analytic exponential tail; binary eigenvector and eigenvalue inputs interpreted exactly.

same_refined_source_precession.rigorous_inputs: Exact rational source-matrix residuals, exact Sturm index intervals, uniform rational self-field/state bounds and exact spin-matrix phase bounds imply the rational finite-g enclosure. same_member_intrinsic_stationary_witness.preparation: positive-spin line selected within the actual full zero-field ground doublet, with its computed transverse self-field
same_member_intrinsic_stationary_witness.scope: Numerical stationary-residual witness on the same refined weak-coupling member, including its nonzero self-field. These residuals are not an interval proof of a particular exact nonlinear stationary eigenvector.

same_refined_source_precession.source: same finite |D_W| matter and unique quasistatic field at kappa=1e-14; this coupling is a declared weak-self-field accuracy choice, not a fitted physical electromagnetic strength

uniform_quasistatic_bounds.finite_time_Duhamel_bound: For every normalized trajectory, ||psi_qs(t)-exp(-itK0)psi(0)||<=|t|*uniform_kernel_change_upper. This uses a uniform perturbation of the fixed unitary, with no nonlinear Gronwall factor.

uniform_spin_phase_certificate.method: Exact binary-vector rational matrix elements of Sx+iSy; triangle inequality and integer-square-root bound, uniform over every time.

zero_probe_all_mode_gap.proof: Re<beta v,Dv>=<v,Mv> and singular-value min-max; the scalar M0 separates into three exact tridiagonal axes. Four internal copies give the fifth-eigenvalue bound.

zero_probe_exact_matrix_residual.method: Exact rational matvec of degree18 link-phase polynomial, coordinate residual norm bound and analytic exponential tail; binary eigenvector and eigenvalue inputs interpreted exactly.

witness_method: Numerical states and fields are immutable witnesses. The producer rebuilds the declared operator, current and Maxwell equations and verifies their residuals. Regeneration uses the same full sparse eigenproblem and no target g.
